comment: The eight bit outputs are 5V, not the 10V the rest of the plugin uses for gates; Rungler.cpp sets them to 5.0f while every other gate output uses HCV_GATE_MAG at 10V. The stepped output is built from bits 6, 7 and 8 as 32, 64 and 128 divided by 255, so its highest level is about 88 per cent of the Scale setting rather than all of it.
